required_guards.requirement: Use GetInsertionPoint_1: seven payload outputs plus CSI status; retain both mirror flags. Legacy overload is insufficient.
Retain signed U1/U2/U3/R1/R2/R3 and F1/F2/F3/M1/M2/M3 in JOINT_LOCAL coordinates, with exact object/element/selection/step/source indexes. Do not relabel Global.

GetSpring nonzero means absence OR failure. Preserve UNAVAILABLE, never fabricate six zeros. Coupled/named spring semantics remain unavailable to this bounded normalizer; required calibration fields block.

GetSpringCoupled serialization and transformation-matrix ordering are not documented in installed help. Their signatures are proved, but no normalization or live use is authorized by this matrix alone.
Nonempty GetLoadForce includes undocumented LcStep. Retain raw rows; assigned-load evidence is UNAVAILABLE until step semantics are proved. Never collapse steps.
Current bounded normalizer supports only present enum 6, kN/m/C. No setter. Explicit at most five frames, sixteen joints and 2000 total returned rows; account every raw call.
Explicit separate displacement/reaction joint scopes; any missing requested group makes that entire result snapshot UNAVAILABLE, not zero or an accepted partial result.
Block advanced axes and nonempty frame spring assignment outside the frozen definition. Preserve exact baseline axes and verify fresh coordinates within 1e-6 mm unit-roundtrip precision only.

Before live calls verify exact saved copied file/version, lock, all case statuses and output selections. Prove unchanged file/units/lock/status/selections afterward; no analysis/design/save/selection setter.

semantic_sources.finding: Six signed joint-local translations/rotations; [L] and radians, with full row identity.
Six signed joint-local reactions from restraints/springs/grounded links, force and force-length units.
Both mirror flags, stiffness transform, cardinal point, two offset vectors and coordinate system.
Summed joint-local six diagonal stiffness terms; nonzero does not distinguish absent spring from read failure.
Signature only; coupled coefficient ordering not proved.
LcStep present but undefined; do not infer static/staged semantics.
Option 1 uses six stiffnesses plus named coordinate basis; option 2 uses soil/footing/period. Named links need separate proof.
Weight/volume and mass/volume; fixed kN/m/s dimensional conversion uses 1000 kg per kN s²/m. Temperature is explicitly the getter default 0.
Official assignment semantics identify six end-release DOFs and same-order partial-fixity springs; inspected as documentation only, setter never called.

normalization_basis.load_direction: retained literal basis, including positive gravity = negative Global Z
normalization_basis.geometry: Accepted baseline mm coordinates retained after independent live m readback agrees within 1e-6 mm and identical saved file hash.
